content.title: SoftBank Vision Fund to lay off 20% of employees in shift to bold AI bets, source and memo say
content.summary: SoftBank Group will lay off nearly 20% of its Vision Fund team globally as it shifts resources to founder Masayoshi Son’s large-scale artificial intelligence bets in the United States, according to a memo seen by Reuters and a source familiar with the plan.  Vision Fund currently has over 300 employees globally.  The move signals a pivot away from a broad portfolio of startup investments.

content.title: Soccer-MLS strikes South Korea broadcast deals after LAFC's Son Heung-min signing
content.summary: Major League Soccer has signed multiyear broadcast partnerships with South Korean streaming platform Coupang Play and sports network SPOTV to air Los Angeles FC matches across South Korea, the league said on Thursday. The agreements come on the heels of LAFC's signing of South Korea captain Son Heung-min, a blockbuster move that has drawn global attention and ignited interest among South Korean fans. "Son Heung-min's arrival at LAFC represents a cultural and sporting milestone - not just for MLS, but for global football," Seth Bacon, MLS's executive vice president of media, told Reuters in an email.
